name: Muzzle
description: The built-in animal-muzzle feature (a protruding snout replacing the flat nose+mouth). Unlike ears/horns/halo, `muzzle` the boolean is NOT a core avatar3d_viewer.py CUSTOM_FIELDS entry anymore - it's resolved from **extra_traits by build_character()/build_rig() (see those functions' own docstrings) purely as a local GATE passed into _build_face()/_build_head_bundle() to skip the normal nose+mouth geometry; the snout-replacement geometry itself lives entirely here.
